source.notes: ICSE Class IX school second semester examination paper (school not named). Header prints 'SECOND SEMESTER EXAMINATION 2024-25 (English Medium)', 'Class - IX', 'CHEMISTRY (THEORY)', 'Time : 2 hrs.', 'M.M.- 80'; examYear 2025 is the later year of the printed session (also the year in the file name). Section-A (40 marks) Q1-Q7 print only group totals (15, 05, 2.5, 2.5, 05, 05, 05), so each is kept as one entry; Q3 and Q4 (2.5 each) are combined into one entry numbered '3-4' (5 marks) because the marks field cannot hold halves. Section-B (40 marks, attempt any four) restarts numbering at 1; its parts carry printed marks and are split (Section-A entries have part null, Section-B entries have parts i)-iv)). Pack marks total 100 because of the Section-B choice. The PDF has no text layer (watermark only); text was OCRed with RapidOCR and corrected against the page images. Chemical subscripts are kept flat. No answer key is printed; no official answers exist.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text: Multiple choice questions- i) The chemical formula of Gypsum- a. CaSO4.2H2O b. CaSO4.5H2O c. CuSO4.2H2O d. CuSO4.5H2O ii) +ΔT indicates an- a. Endothermic Reaction b. Oxidation Reaction c. Redox Reaction d. Exothermic Reaction iii) Which scientist proved that water is not an element but a compound. a. A. Lavoisier b. W. Ostwald c. Henry Cavendish d. Louis Pasteur iv) Which solute dissolves in Benzene. a. Alcohol b. Rubber c. Petrol d. Acetone v) On moving across a period in a Modern periodic table, the number of shells- a. Remain same b. Increases c. Decrease d. Decrease then increase vi) Which scientist proposed atomic theory- a. Democritus b. William Crookes c. John Dalton d. J.J. Thomson vii) The maximum number of electron in any shell is represented by- a. 2n² b. 3n² c. 4n² d. 5n² viii) Which bond is formed due to mutual sharing of an electron between the non-metallic element- a. Electrovalent bond b. Covalent bond c. Ionic bond d. Metallic bond ix) Which scientist arranged elements in increasing order of atomic number- a. Dobereiner b. Newland c. Mendeleeff d. Moseley x) Halogen means- a. Water producer b. Base producer c. Salt producer d. Acid producer xi) Alkaline Earth Metal are present in which group. a. Group 1 b. Group 2 c. Group 3 d. Group 4 xii) Which scientist recognized hydrogen as an element. a. Robert Boyle b. Lavoisier c. John Dalton d. Henry Cavendish xiii) The flame is used for welding and cutting of metals. a. Oxy-hydrogen flame b. Nitro-hydrogen flame c. Silver-hydrogen flame d. Water-hydrogen flame xiv) Absolute Zero temperature- a. -273°C b. -274°C d. -275°C d. -276°C xv) The gas which in presence of U.V. light gives two atoms of the same gas. a. Oxygen b. Ozone c. Methane d. L.P.G.
